name: Zahara de la Sierra (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Zahara de la Sierra (a tower with a lion and a ladder on white).
history: Municipal flag of Zahara de la Sierra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Zahara de la Sierra arms — tower with lion and ladder on white
